about_the_game:
■Story

One day, the "Land of Sweets"" is suddenly attacked by a wizard, and all of its inhabitants are captured.

The only one who escapes is a young man named "Pumpulte", a resident of the Land of Sweets. He sets off on an adventure to rescue the people of his homeland, traversing three different kingdoms—the "Land of Sweets", the "Land of Monsters", and the "Land of Wizards"—and making new friends along the way.

----------------------------------------------------------

■Overview & Features

Difficulty Easy

Genre　　RPG

Playtime Approx. 90 minutes (current public release)

This is an exploration RPG with a Halloween theme, featuring sweets, wizards, and monsters. While the maps and characters have a distinct Halloween vibe, this isn't central to the story, so you can enjoy the game anytime of the year (this is super important!).

----------------------------------------------------------

■Despite its Cute Appearance, a Slightly Dark Story

The protagonist, "Pumpulte", a resident of the Land of Sweets, embarks on an adventure through three different kingdoms—the Land of Sweets, the Land of Monsters, and the Land of Wizards—to rescue the inhabitants of his homeland who were captured by a wizard.

■A Dash of Novel Elements

Throughout your adventure, you'll meet a cast of unique characters who will support the protagonist. You'll witness a variety of interactions among them, sometimes to lighten the mood, and other times to deliver important messages for the story.

■Explore Actively to Uncover the Secrets!

This game features two different multi-endings. The most crucial part is to explore each map thoroughly, as the ending will change based on your actions and choices.

■Don't Know What to Do? Don't Worry!

From the start, the game features a "Guidebook" function where you can find helpful tips for your adventure and basic game information. It also includes extras like the game's setting资料集 (materials/compendium), so be sure to check them out during your breaks.

----------------------------------------------------------

■Regarding Live Streams and Video Content

To allow for future additions and refinements, all streaming and video content are prohibited until an official announcement is made.

■Regarding Screenshots on Social Media or Blogs

Please refrain from posting screenshots of events that display still illustrations. Other than that, you're welcome to upload them.

----------------------------------------------------------

Controls

■ Keyboard**

Z / Enter　　Confirm, talk, examine

X / Esc　　　Cancel, back, menu

Arrow Keys　Move character, move cursor

■Mouse

Tap on map　　　Move character, move cursor

Tap on target　 Confirm, talk, examine, cancel, back, menu

You can customize your controls by going to "Options" → "Control Settings".

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of swimwear, depictions of physical injury without bloodshed

short_description: This is an adventure story about a protagonist from "The Land of Sweets" who sets out to rescue their friends captured by a wizard. The protagonist travels through three distinct realms, meeting companions and confronting each land's unique problems and truths.
